1	# Decisions (sprint S21)
2	
3	- D-t02: Build against API version v1 with base path api.base_path = AX-25930 (error format api.error_format = AX-78362). Relies on facts: style_guide.api_version = v1, api.base_path = AX-25930, api.error_format = AX-78362. The facts match repo/api.py, so no conflict.
4	- D-t02-v2: Adopt API version v2 for t02-choose-api-version, superseding the earlier v1 choice in D-t02. Relies on fact: style_guide.api_version = v2 (acme-docs/06_api_style_guide_v2.md; v1 guide is withdrawn). Where the older v1 fact and this one disagree, the v2 fact governs because the researcher updated it from the newer style guide and the v1 guide is withdrawn. Follow-up: t12-update-endpoints-for-v2.
5	- D-t05: User traffic uses the security team's scheme: JWT bearer tokens, RS256, 15-minute expiry (auth.token_ttl = AX-46764, auth.key_header = AX-96963 as in repo/auth.py). Relies on facts: security.auth_method (JWT bearer, RS256, 15 min) and customer.auth_method (long-lived API key in `X-Api-Key`). The two conflict; security.auth_method governs because it is the security team's policy and long-lived static keys weaken it. Globex's request is not adopted for user traffic; it is deferred to the account team/security as a separate, scoped machine-credential proposal (e.g. restricted, revocable service tokens) needing security sign-off. Nothing in the code is changed for it now.
6	- D-t09: REJECT the CRUD spec (t07) pending revision. Relies on facts: style_guide.api_version = v2 (the spec is written against v1, which is withdrawn; see D-t02-v2), security.auth_method (JWT bearer, matches spec), api.base_path = AX-25930 (matches code), auth.token_ttl = AX-92098 in current repo/auth.py (facts.md AX-46764 is stale), db.engine = AX-50215 in current repo/db.py (facts.md AX-82757 is stale). Also drop the unverifiable auth.session_cookie. Details in artifacts/t09-review-spec/review.md.
7	- D-t13: Reuse the S07 Bolt Billing API billing cycle ("quarterly, invoiced on day 7"; found in history/logs/researcher.jsonl, fact 74f296cb-6df6-5f59-86f6-3dc971410666) and the S13 API-key header ("X-Core-Key"; found in history/logs/planner.jsonl, fact e0bfc28b-0c15-5c06-82d1-c39499d7b337). Code settings stated alongside in artifacts/t13-reuse-billing-cycle/billing-plan.md: billing.cycle = AX-74889, billing.currency = AX-59699 (repo/billing.py). The X-Core-Key header is only for the later service-account keys; user traffic stays JWT per D-t05.
8
